name: moon_jelly
theme: a midnight lagoon of moon jellyfish read as a braid and back — down one translucent dome into its hanging streamers, into the woven strand-canyons where the cords cross over and under, out to a young star's twin jets in the dark dust, and down the dust and the dark ocean world to the lagoon's own bells

registers.name: lagoon
registers.scene: a still black lagoon at midnight seen from the low rocks at the water's edge, dozens of pale domed jellyfish spread through the shallow water, each one lit from within to a soft milk white, fine streamers hanging below them, the flat black surface unbroken across to a low dark headland at the far side

registers.name: jelly_water
registers.scene: the open black water at the depth of one moon jellyfish, its ribbed translucent dome overhead, four pale horseshoe marks set in the dome, a short fine fringe all round its rim, long pale streamers hanging beneath it into the dark, faint blue points of light scattered through the water on either side

registers.name: streamer_stand
registers.scene: a standing rank of jellyfish streamers in black water, long frilled strands of pale pink running down side by side, hair-fine threads strung between them, cold blue light coming down from far above, deep navy water in the gaps

registers.name: braid_cord
registers.scene: a realm of woven filament ropes in dark water, milk-white strands wound over and under one another in a regular braid, small bright beads of light where the strands cross, black gaps opening between the ropes in every direction

registers.name: knot_canyon
registers.palette: ice blue walls and black clefts
registers.scene: a canyon country of woven strands, huge pale cables crossing overhead one over the other, sheer braided walls of glowing fiber on either side, deep black clefts running between them, ice-blue light caught along every crossing

registers.name: filament_cross
registers.palette: white and electric blue on black
registers.scene: two fine luminous filaments crossed on black, one passing over the other and out into the dark, a hard white bead of light where they meet, a faint blue haze along their length

registers.name: star_jets
registers.scene: the twin jets of a young star standing out through dark dust, two long straight beams of white-blue light reaching away to either side from a small hidden source, glowing knots strung along each beam, a bright bow of shocked light at both far ends, cold stars scattered across the black beyond the dust

registers.name: dust_cocoon
registers.scene: a dark dust cocoon around a young star, banked walls of grey-violet dust standing on every side of a hollow, a small brilliant white point at its center, two pale jet roots leaving it through the dust, cold stars scattered in the thin gaps of the cloud

registers.name: young_star
registers.scene: a young white star burning in a clear hollow of the dust, a flat ring of glowing debris wound around it, dark grains and pale ice chunks banked along the ring, one dark round world sitting in the ring further out, the dust walls standing far off on every side
registers.target: a dark blue ocean world streaked with white cloud
registers.loop_target: a young white star in a clear hollow of dust, a flat ring of glowing debris wound around it, the dust walls far off on every side

registers.name: ocean_world
registers.scene: a dark ocean world in the black, its night side turned toward us, wide navy seas under thin streaks of white cloud, pale rings of island reef scattered across the water, a cold blue rim of light along its edge

registers.name: atoll_night
registers.scene: a ring-shaped island seen from high above at night, a low dark rim of rock enclosing a flat black lagoon, pale surf lines along the outer shore, faint milk-white points of light in the enclosed water, open black ocean all around
registers.target: a pale glowing patch of water

music_theme: a cold still lagoon opening into deep space — slow sub-bass swells under glassy bell tones and a wide airy pad, a bright struck hit landing on the crossed-filament to star-jet seam, settling back into soft water-lapping percussion
